scope: Historical container/shipment addresses whose numeric values are explicitly transcribed in the Cambridge catalogue, separated from cases where an old number is known to survive but remains unread online.
graph_rule: Only explicit numeric historical addresses become address nodes. Identifier-present-but-unread objects remain pending nodes until image/object inspection.

source_control_rules: The numeral alone does not establish that two inventory generations use the same numbering system.
Box 2 or Box 3 in a modern-surviving label is not automatically the same box as Box 2 or Box 3 in RAS BHH/11/1 (1837).
A volume-level old address may describe a historical packet/copy family now bound together; physical title/cover inspection is required to determine its exact scope.
Do not promote pending identifier nodes to numeric graph nodes by inference from topic or modern order.
